name: Golden Residency Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Real estate in Bahrain valued at BHD 130,000 or more (~USD 345,000) -- reduced from the earlier BHD 200,000 threshold on 26 November 2025.
requirements.fix_path: Purchase qualifying real estate at or above the threshold.

requirements.blocker_text: At least 5 years' employment in Bahrain with average monthly salary above BHD 2,000.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of qualifying high-earning employment in Bahrain.

requirements.blocker_text: At least 15 years' employment history in Bahrain (government or private sector) with average monthly pension above BHD 2,000.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 15 years of qualifying employment history in Bahrain.

requirements.blocker_text: Average monthly pension above BHD 4,000, without a Bahrain employment history requirement.
Entrepreneurs, exceptional academics, athletes, artists, authors, or inventors, nominated by a government agency -- no fixed quantitative threshold published.

outcome.duration_length: permanent, renewed every 10 years (not a flat 10-year visa as commonly reported)

sources.title: Nationality, Passports and Residence Affairs (NPRA), Bahrain -- Golden Residence Permit, Talented Individuals category: entrepreneurs, exceptional academics/athletes/artists/authors/inventors, nominated by government agencies

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Bahrain). STATUS: DRAFT -- only the 'talented individuals' group's hard requirement is tier-1 sourced (NPRA's own page); the other four groups (property, employee, retiree, non-resident retiree) rest on a press-wire release that directly quotes an NPRA official but is not NPRA's own published page -- treated as tier 3, not elevated to tier 1, since it's press distribution rather than a primary government document. Since this dataset requires ALL hard requirements to be tier-1 for published status, the whole file stays draft. The official goldenresidency.gov.bh FAQ portal was robots-blocked in every fetch attempt in this build -- re-attempting that fetch, or NPRA's own general Golden Residency landing page (as opposed to just the talented-individuals sub-page), is the top priority for upgrading this file. IMPORTANT CORRECTION: the property threshold was CUT from BHD 200,000 to BHD 130,000 on 26 November 2025, a 35% reduction -- do not use the older, more commonly-cited BHD 200,000 figure. STRUCTURAL CLARIFICATION: NPRA frames this as genuine PERMANENT residency, renewed every 10 years for a BHD 300 fee, not a flat 10-year temporary visa as it is frequently described in secondary coverage. This route does NOT lead to citizenship -- Golden Residency and Bahraini naturalisation are entirely separate systems (naturalisation remains governed by years-of-ordinary-residence and Royal discretion, see bh_citizenship_naturalisation.json), and holding Golden Residency does not appear to shorten the naturalisation clock based on sources found.
